title: Lifestyle Intervention in Obese Arab Women
brief_summary: The study protocol aims to test the hypothesis that a lifestyle intervention program aimed to increase leisure-time physical activity and reduce body weight will improve the parameters of the metabolic syndrome and quality of life among obese, non-diabetic Arab women
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Obesity (BMI: 30-40 kg/squared meter)
* Female Gender
* Being 35-54 years old

Exclusion Criteria:

* Diabetic

A contraindication for physical activity
